name: Shadow Raid Pack
displayDescription:
This pass gives you instant access to:
• GPNVG-18 panoramic night vision device
• XTREM combat suit (SRC)
• Shadow Raid camouflage finish for most weapon systems (*)

There are no minimum requirements to use this pass. *Excluding select weapons including G22A2, M110A3, MP7A2, PKM, Deagle Mk XIX, M17, Mk 25 Mod 0, USP45 Tactical, V226R, V320

name: Airborne Recon Pack
displayDescription:
This pass gives you instant access to:
• SRTV all-terrain vehicle
• MPC 2.0 plate carrier (custom)
• Pouch zip-on panel 2.0 vest attachment (custom)
• M4 Flat vest attachment (custom)
• PCU Block 0, level 5 combat uniform (VariCam)
• Sun hat (modified) with foilage covers

You also receive the recon weapon camoflage on:
• M4A1
• Mk 17 Mod 0
• SCAR-L
• G36KA2
• MP7A1
• MP7A2
• G22A2
• M17
• M110
• M110A3
• M2010
• Mark 4 LR/T M2 (Primary Optic)
• SU-231A/PEQ (Primary Optic)

Vehicle component upgrades and host weapons must be purchased separately. There are no minimum requirements to use this pass.

name: Chinook CH-47
displayDescription:
This pass gives you instant access to:
• CH-47D 'Chinook' medium-lift transport helicopter
• A2CU 'RL1' flight suit (OCP)

Vehicle component upgrades must be purchased separately. There are no minimum requirements to use this pass.

name: RAL 8000 Camo Pack
displayDescription:
This gamepass gives you instant access (*) to the RAL 8000 camo on the:
• RF416 A5
• G36A2
• G36KA2
• Type 20
• MP7A1
• MP7A2
• USP45 Tactical
• UMP45
• Sturmgriff attachment
• RF416 30x MR556 magazine

*Weapons have to be purchased separately prior to equipping weapon camo
No minimum rank or EXP is needed to use weapon skins.
